# Keybinding reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-cheat-sheet.py from keybindings.json. -->

[Download the A3 landscape PDF](assets/neovim-a3-cheat-sheet.pdf).

Leader is **comma**. Keys are in **Normal mode** unless marked otherwise. Type comma sequences one key at a time; hold Control for `Ctrl-` keys. `Enter` is `<CR>`, `Shift-Tab` is `<S-Tab>`, and uppercase letters are significant.

**Full** means mac_home, mac_office, ubuntu or rhel8_vm. **Minimal** means euhpc3 or minimal. **Work Linux** means ubuntu, rhel8_vm or euhpc3. LSP and Git buffer maps require their clients/plugins to attach. Plugin defaults and native commands are explicitly labeled.

## Everyday editing

**All profiles**

| Keys / command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `jk [Insert]` | Leave Insert mode |
| `,e / -` | Explore files / parent directory |
| `Tab / Shift-Tab` | Next / previous buffer |
| `,x` | Force-delete buffer (unsaved edits too) |
| `,pp` | Toggle paste mode |
| `,sn` | Save without autocommands |
| `,yp / ,yr` | Copy absolute / relative path to + |
| `,<Enter>` | Clear search highlighting |
| `,ot` | Open shell terminal in a split |
| `Ctrl-\ Ctrl-n` | Leave Terminal mode (native) |
| `,ut [Full]` | Toggle undo history tree |
| `< / > [Visual]` | Indent and keep selection |

Source: `lua/core/keymaps.lua`.

## Windows and tabs

**All profiles**

| Keys / command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `,v / ,h` | Vertical / horizontal split |
| `Ctrl-h/j/k/l` | Focus left/down/up/right window |
| `,xs` | Close current split |
| `Up / Down` | Shrink / grow window height |
| `Left / Right` | Shrink / grow window width |
| `,to / ,tx` | New / close tab page |
| `,tn / ,tp` | Next / previous tab page |

Mac profiles extend Ctrl-h/j/k/l across Herdr panes.

Source: `lua/core/keymaps.lua`.

## EUHPC3 / minimal overrides

**Minimal profiles only**

| Keys / command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `,e / -` | Netrw / parent directory |
| `,b` | New empty buffer |
| `,se` | Equalize window sizes |
| `Shift-h / Shift-l` | Previous / next buffer |
| `Ctrl-d / Ctrl-u` | Half-page scroll, then center |
| `Ctrl-] / Ctrl-t` | Follow tag / return (native) |

No fzf, LSP, DAP, Git plugins or installs. EUHPC3 retains work tags and manual AUTO commands.

Source: `lua/core/minimal.lua`.

## Formatting and whitespace

**All profiles; ,cf needs a formatting client**

| Keys / command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `,cf [Full]` | Format buffer through LSP / none-ls |
| `,cw` | Trim trailing whitespace in buffer |
| `,cw [Visual]` | Trim trailing whitespace in selection |
| `,swc` | Set local textwidth to 120; add t flag |
| `,cwc` | Clear local textwidth |
| `gq{motion}` | Reflow text (native) |

Formatting is manual, not on save. Lua: StyLua; Python: Ruff; web: Prettier; shell: shfmt; C: clangd.

Source: `lua/core/keymaps.lua; lua/plugins/autoformatting.lua`.

## Completion and snippets

**Full profiles; Insert mode (snippet keys also Select)**

| Keys / command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl-Space` | Request completion |
| `Ctrl-n / Ctrl-p` | Next / previous completion |
| `Ctrl-y` | Accept completion (select=true) |

## Verilog AUTO

**Work Linux profiles; Verilog/SystemVerilog buffers**

| Keys / command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `,va` | Expand AUTO via work Emacs wrapper |
| `,vd` | Delete AUTO expansion |

Requires MALI_HOME + mrun. Waits for Emacs; updates the buffer without saving it.

Source: `lua/config/verilogauto.lua`.

## Git hunks and blame

**Full profiles; Gitsigns attached to buffer**

| Keys / command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `;c / \c` | Next / previous hunk |
| `,hs / ,hr` | Stage / reset hunk (also Visual) |
| `,hS / ,hR` | Stage / reset entire buffer |
| `,hp / ,hi` | Popup / inline hunk preview |
| `,hb` | Full blame for current line |
| `,hd / ,hD` | Diff vs index / previous commit |
| `,hq / ,hQ` | Quickfix: buffer / repository hunks |
| `,tg` | Toggle Git signs |
| `,tb` | Toggle current-line blame |
| `,tw` | Toggle word diff |
| `ih [Visual/operator]` | Select hunk text object |
| `:copen` | Open quickfix (native) |

Reset discards changes. In diff mode, ;c and \c use native hunk navigation.

Source: `lua/plugins/gitsigns.lua`.

## Inside Fugitive status

**Full profiles; buffer-local plugin defaults**

| Keys / command | Action |
| --- | --- |

## Workspace selection

**Type colon commands INSIDE Neovim**

| Keys / command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `:Workspace` | Show active profile |
| `:Workspace mac_home` | Save home Mac profile |
| `:Workspace mac_office` | Save work Mac profile |
| `:Workspace ubuntu` | Save Ubuntu profile |
| `:Workspace rhel8_vm` | Save RHEL8 VM profile |
| `:Workspace euhpc3` | Save lightweight HPC profile |
| `:Workspace minimal` | Save generic plugin-free profile |

Restart after selecting. NVIM_WORKSPACE overrides the saved, Git-ignored workspace file.

Source: `lua/core/workspace.lua`.
